slides.headline: 6 AI PROMPTS THAT CATCH EXACTLY WHERE YOUR BUSINESS IS QUIETLY BLEEDING MONEY
1) FIND EVERY SUBSCRIPTION YOU FORGOT
slides.body: 25% of software spending goes to tools nobody uses, per Gartner. "Here are my business expenses for the last 6 months. Find every recurring charge I probably don't need"

slides.headline: 2) FIND WHY CUSTOMERS LEAVE
slides.body: Replacing a lost customer costs 5x more than keeping one. "Here are my last 20 customer complaints. What's the #1 reason people quit and write me an email that wins them back"

slides.headline: 3) CATCH WHERE YOU'RE UNDERCHARGING
slides.body: A 1% price increase adds 8% to profits, per McKinsey. Most never check. "Here's my pricing page and 3 competitor links. Where am I charging less"

slides.headline: 4) FIND WHERE YOUR WEBSITE LOSES BUYERS
slides.body: 97 out of 100 visitors leave most websites without buying. "Here's a screenshot of my checkout page. List every reason a buyer would leave before paying"

slides.headline: 5) SPOT SHIFTS THAT COST YOU EXTRA
slides.body: Payroll is the biggest expense in most businesses, and wasted hours hide inside it. "Here's my employee schedule from last month. Find every shift where I had more people than I needed"

slides.headline: 6) CATCH VENDORS QUIETLY RAISING PRICES
slides.body: Suppliers raise prices by 3 to 5% a year and most businesses never notice. "Here are my invoices from this quarter and last year. Flag every price that went up more than 3%"

hook_tournament.why: "Money you're LOSING" hits in present tense — it's happening to me right now, not some abstract future problem. The accountant angle (#2) is clever but 'won't think to run' costs a half-second re-read, and at 2am that's a swipe-past.

hook_sharpen.why: "Bleeding money" is visceral and physical — it triggers urgency in a way "losing" and "leaks" don't, and it lands in under a second. Runner-up [3] has the FOMO hook of "most people miss" but "catch money leaks" is slightly awkward phrasing that costs it a beat.
